# Free LLM APIs with no credit card required

LLM APIs you can start calling without entering a payment method — filtered live from a continuously-verified dataset.

[← All collections](README.md) · [Interactive explorer ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/) · [Main list](../README.md)

Every provider below offers free API access with **no card required** to get started (`card_required: false`, confirmed against their own docs). Rows where the requirement is not stated are excluded rather than assumed.
